correctness.rationale: On e1=1, the exact invariant-ring quotient gives a smooth affine curve with function field that of D_n. Expanding -n[z^n]log(1-e1 z+e2 z²-e3 z³) gives the top ordinary part n(-1)^(d-1)u^(d-1)(v-u), so Q is smooth. On e1=0, points with e3=0 are the three permutations of [1:-1:0]; the invariant equation with e2 normalized to 1 has linear terms proportional to e3-e1, so the map extends there to Q. Tangency at any other point requires X^(n-1)=Y^(n-1)=Z^(n-1); the only equally sized triples summing to zero are the two cube-root points up to scale. Stabilizers are trivial at the remaining points: a transposition's +1 line on e1=0 gives [1:1:-2] up to permutation, not on the Fermat curve; its -1 point is in the special orbit; the 3-cycle eigenpoints are already accounted for. At a generic orbit the ratio e3²/e2³ determines the unordered normalized root triple up to scale and separates cubic branch coefficients. At a cube-root point e1,e2 are local coordinates after e3=1 because the roots are distinct; direct coefficient extraction gives e2=(ell+1)e1²+… in residue 5 and e1=-ell e2²+… in residue 1. Thus the intersection order upstairs is 1 or 2 respectively. The order-three quotient changes the orders of (a,b) from (3,3) or (3,6) to (1,1) or (1,2), with the reported leading coefficient in each case. Bezout exhausts the normalization branches: ell or ell-1 generic plus one distinguished. Distinct unit cubic coefficients give contact 3; the special branch gives contact 1 or 2. This yields the tangent cones, delta and Milnor formulas, node at 11 and tacnode at 13. Independently, the degree-six Riemann–Hurwitz ramification sum is 3(n+1)+4, giving the stated genus and total defect.
residual_risks: The invariants classify contacts, not analytic moduli. The finite symbolic samples only corroborate the all-n proof.

value.rationale: For the natural affine equation from symmetric invariants, the ordinary plane closure is an easy model to write down but normalization/genus alone hides how it fails to be smooth. The uniform branch profiles, explicit tangent types and allocation of the entire genus defect to P make this plane model usable in local intersection calculations. The two small examples illustrate a general distinction valid also at composite allowed degrees.
residual_risks: No claim of analytic equivalence between different n or of arithmetic reduction is supported.
